import xml.dom.minidom as minidom
dom = minidom.parse('unpacked/word/document.xml')
body = dom.getElementsByTagName('w:body')[0]
for i, p in enumerate(body.getElementsByTagName('w:p')):
    texts = []
    for t in p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'):
        texts.append(t.firstChild.data if t.firstChild else '')
    pstyle = ''
    pPr = p.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')
    if pPr:
        pstyle_el = pPr[0].getElementsByTagName('w:pStyle')
        if pstyle_el:
            pstyle = pstyle_el[0].getAttribute('w:val')
    print(i, repr(''.join(texts)), 'style=' + pstyle)
"
